 50% off Loved01 Loved01: Body Care
 Create intentional moments of self-care. John Legend brings a simpler approach to total body care with Loved01, created with pH-balanced, dermatologist approved formulas that are gentle enough for sensitive skin. The It's All Love Set is made up of the brand's bestsellers and every formula has a blend of oils, extracts and butters, including rosehip and sea buckthorn oils for replenishing, strengthening and softening skin. The set includes hand wash and two cleansing bars in the signature First Love scent (subtle lavender with a hint of herb) for gentle daily washes; customer-favorite shaving cream for a smooth, comfortable shave; and a 15-ounce hand and body lotion for moisture that lasts. The Made With Love Set is John's favorite, plus a glow boost. It starts with John's personal favorite, Loved01 face and body moisturizer with a rich, whipped texture and a blend of plant-based butters and oils; the face and body oil, made with lightweight safflower oil for extra softness and a healthy-looking glow; and two cleansing bars, which gently wash away the day without stripping your skin -- all fragrance-free. Sink Sets pair their gentle hand wash with hand and body lotion. The wash lathers up with avocado oil, aloe vera and vitamin E, so it cleans without stripping. The lotion has ceramides to restore and protect your skin, shea butter for deep nourishment, and jojoba oil for moisture that lasts. Choose from First Love or fragrance-free -- both bottles sit on a sleek black tray with the Loved01 logo, so your sink looks clean and polished. Choose from an assortment of singles and sets. Shipping is $4.95 or free over $50. $6.00 - $36.50

 Shop Now 50% off CONNETIX CONNETIX: Magnetic Tile Sets
 Build unique creations with CONNETIX, an award-winning magnetic tile brand known for its innovative designs centered around learning through open-ended play. Vibrant tile designs feature super strong magnets and Smart Spin technology to inspire children to build, explore and create, learning as they play. More than just a distinctive design, the CONNETIX signature bevel enhances durability, creates a lighter tile for bigger builds, and produces beautiful light refractions. It's a defining feature that makes every CONNETIX creation instantly recognizable. Safety is built into every CONNETIX tile, made from nontoxic ABS plastic that's free from BPA and phthalates, and each tile is ultrasonically welded and reinforced with metal rivets to securely seal the magnets inside. Choose from a big assortment of sets to start creating. Shipping is $9 or free over $100. $19.50 - $109.50

 Restore healthy hair from scalp to root. Innersense Organic Beauty is stylist-founded hair care that brings professional results to your everyday routine, with products for all hair types and patterns. Hydrating Cream Hairbath is a rich, creamy shampoo that gently cleanses while restoring softness, bounce, and shine to dry, damaged, medium to thick hair. Formulated with organic shea butter, monoi, avocado, and tamanu oils, it nourishes thirsty strands and helps smooth frizz while enhancing your natural texture. Hydrating Cream Conditioner is rich and silicone-free, featuring organic shea butter and coconut oil to soften strands and help control frizz. Rice, quinoa, and flaxseed help strengthen hair and improve elasticity to reduce breakage, leaving hair softer, smoother and shinier. The Sweet Spirit Leave-In Conditioner makes hair easier to manage while smoothing frizz and adding shine without weighing it down. Made with aloe vera, tamanu oil, and honey, it helps hair retain moisture, with a delicate lavender-sage scent. Use after washing or between wash days to refresh all hair types and textures.
